description: SSOT for all border radius token values. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-radius-sm.role: Small radius — checkboxes, tags, small inputs

TK-radius-lg.role: Large radius — modals, large cards, panels

TK-radius-xl.role: Extra large radius — containers, image cards

TK-radius-full.role: Fully rounded — pills, badges, avatars, circular buttons
